_comment: The host copies these into verification_plan entries with required_by=repository (VER-5). Commands are the npm scripts CI runs after `npm ci` (Node 24). CI skips the steps of all five jobs on docs-only PRs (.github/scripts/changes.sh). engines and e2e run in mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.65.0-noble. e2e: CI splits the suite into 12 shards (`npm run test:e2e -- <args>` from .github/scripts/shard-plan.mjs); the bare command runs the same tests, locally with more workers and reused servers. There is no README or CONTRIBUTING; ci.yml and package.json are the only sources for checks. Review: the owner does the required review personally, after the PR is opened and CI is green; workers and the host never approve or merge.

branch_protection.source: gh api repos/DomineYH/observer/branches/main/protection (required_approving_review_count=1, enforce_admins=false, strict=false); rulesets: none. Owner decision 2026-11-25: the owner reviews every PR after CI completes, so require_review stays true.
